# netbox_config_context_profile (Data Source)

A NetBox config context profile (extras.configcontextprofile): a JSON schema for the config contexts that use it.

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/extras/configcontextprofile/):

> Profiles can be used to organize [configuration contexts](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/extras/configcontext/) and to enforce a desired structure for their data. The latter is achieved by defining a [JSON schema](https://json-schema.org/) to which all config contexts assigned to the profile must comply. Any context whose data fails validation against the profile's schema cannot be saved.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_config_context_profile" "test" {
  name = "test-config_context_profile"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `schema` (String) JSON schema the config contexts with this profile must satisfy (use jsonencode()).
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
